aviation_incidents.headline: 美國航空客機客艙霧氣迫使緊急降落 乘客撤離至跑道
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國航空客機客艙出現霧氣後緊急降落，乘客撤離至跑道。報導摘要另稱，起飛後不久氧氣面罩展開，部分乘客從機翼跳下。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: American Airlines Makes Emergency Landing After Cabin Haze Passengers Evacuate Onto Runway
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An American Airlines aircraft made an emergency landing after haze appeared in the cabin, and passengers evacuated onto the runway. The report’s summary also says oxygen masks deployed shortly after takeoff and some passengers jumped from the wing.

sources.name: Simple Flying — American Airlines Passengers Evacuate Onto Runway After Cab…

aviation_incidents.headline: LATAM波音767宣告緊急代碼 下降2萬3千英尺後返回利馬
aviation_incidents.summary: LATAM一架波音767飛行途中宣告7700緊急代碼，隨即下降2萬3千英尺，過程中氧氣面罩落下；航機隨後返回利馬。報導未說明事件原因或發生日期。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: LATAM Boeing 767 Declares Emergency Descends 23,000 Feet and Returns to Lima
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A LATAM Boeing 767 declared a 7700 emergency code during flight and made an immediate descent of 23,000 feet, with oxygen masks deploying. The aircraft then returned to Lima. The available account does not state the cause or date of the event.

sources.name: Simple Flying — LATAM Boeing 767 Drops 23,000 Feet As Oxygen Masks Deploy I…

aviation_incidents.headline: 私人飛機中止起飛後偏離拉斯維加斯跑道 機場關閉兩條跑道
aviation_incidents.summary: 10月18日，一架Dassault Falcon 50私人飛機在拉斯維加斯Harry Reid International Airport中止起飛後偏離跑道；機場其後關閉兩條跑道。該機註冊編號為N200SG。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Private Falcon 50 Veers Off Las Vegas Runway After Aborted Takeoff Airport Closes Two Runways
aviation_incidents.summary_en: On October 18, a Dassault Falcon 50 private jet aborted takeoff and veered off the runway at Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas. The airport subsequently closed two runways. The aircraft’s registration was N200SG.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Harry Reid International Airport Closes 2 Runways After Pri…

aviation_incidents.headline: 阿聯酋航空波音777遭鳥擊機鼻錐受損 旅客在德里滯留17小時
aviation_incidents.summary: 阿聯酋航空一架波音777遭遇鳥擊，機鼻錐受損；旅客在德里滯留17小時。航機隔日上午返回杜拜，報導未說明鳥擊發生時間或是否有人受傷。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Bird Strike Damages Emirates Boeing 777 Nose Cone Passengers Stranded in Delhi for 17 Hours
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A bird strike damaged the nose cone of an Emirates Boeing 777, and passengers were stranded in Delhi for 17 hours. The aircraft returned to Dubai the following morning. The account does not state when the strike occurred or whether anyone was injured.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Emirates Passengers Stranded 17 Hours In Delhi After Bird S…

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空布拉格航線載客率約82% 10月起增為每週4班
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空臺北－布拉格直飛航線8月1日開航後，單月載客率約82%；10月起增為每週4班，11月進入歐洲淡季後載客率仍維持8成以上。星宇與華航的航班讓臺捷10月起天天有直飛航班。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX Prague Route Records About 82% Load Factor Adds Fourth Weekly Flight from October
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: STARLUX’s Taipei–Prague nonstop route recorded a monthly load factor of about 82% after launching on August 1. From October, the airline increased service to four flights per week, and load factor remained above 80% in November’s low season. Together with China Airlines, the route provides daily nonstop flights between Taiwan and the Czech Republic from October.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 產經證券 — 星宇直飛布拉格載客率逾8成 拓展觀光助半導體供應鏈串聯

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空預定10月18日執行A340-600最後客運航班 安排仍可能變動
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空預定10月18日執行A340-600最後一班客運服務，標誌其定期A340-600客運營運計畫結束，但仍可能因營運狀況調整。LH419預定由華盛頓杜勒斯飛往法蘭克福；執飛機身尚未獲獨立確認。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa Schedules Final A340-600 Passenger Flight for October 18 Plans Remain Subject to Change
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa is scheduled to operate its final A340-600 passenger service on October 18, marking the planned end of its scheduled A340-600 passenger operations, subject to operational changes. Flight LH419 is due to fly from Washington Dulles to Frankfurt; the aircraft assigned to the service has not been independently confirmed.

sources.name: AeroTime — Lufthansa prepares for final A340-600 flight as 17-year-old…

international_aviation.headline: 勞斯萊斯第二具UltraFan 80示範引擎預計近期運轉
international_aviation.summary: 勞斯萊斯第二具UltraFan 80示範引擎預計近期運轉，報導未提供確切日期，且未表示運轉已經發生。公司正開發供寬體與窄體客機使用的新一代引擎。
international_aviation.headline_en: Rolls-Royce Expects Second UltraFan 80 Demonstrator to Run Soon
international_aviation.summary_en: Rolls-Royce’s second UltraFan 80 demonstrator is expected to run soon, although no precise date is given and the account does not say the run has taken place. The company is developing a new generation of engines for widebody and narrowbody airliners.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Rolls-Royce UltraFan Explained: The Engine Built For The Ne…

international_aviation.headline: 巴基斯坦延長印度航空器領空禁令至2026年11月24日
international_aviation.summary: 巴基斯坦發布新航行通告，將對印度航空器的領空禁令延長至2026年11月24日。禁令涵蓋印度註冊，以及由印度航空公司或營運商擁有、營運或租賃的航空器，包括軍用航班；相關航班須繞飛巴基斯坦。
international_aviation.headline_en: Pakistan Extends Airspace Ban on Indian Aircraft Through November 24, 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: Pakistan issued a new NOTAM extending its airspace ban on Indian aircraft through November 24, 2026. The ban covers Indian-registered aircraft and aircraft owned, operated or leased by Indian airlines or operators, including military flights. Affected flights must route around Pakistan.

sources.name: AeroTime — Pakistan extends airspace ban on Indian airlines

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空將暫停紐約至橙縣跨洲航線 美國航空維持每日飛航
international_aviation.summary: 達美航空準備再次暫停紐約至橙縣的跨洲航班，距離該航線重新推出僅五個月；美國航空則維持每日飛航。報導未說明達美停飛的生效日期或期間。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta to Pause New York–Orange County Route American Airlines Keeps Daily Service
international_aviation.summary_en: Delta Air Lines is set to suspend its transcontinental flights between New York and Orange County, only five months after the route was relaunched. American Airlines will continue daily service. The account does not specify when Delta’s suspension will begin or how long it will last.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Flight Cuts: Delta Air Lines Set To Pause Premium Transcon…
